source.heading: The source
source.excerpt: My factories may make an end of war sooner than your congresses
trail: The Nobel-hosted 1954 peace lecture reports Nobel saying this to Bertha von Suttner. Its account presents the remark as his belief that increasingly destructive weapons might deter war. Source and attribution evidence ↗

The lecture is a later account, not Nobel’s own manuscript. Its English wording and the date of his original remark are not independently established here, so the attribution and rights remain qualified. Read the supporting source ↗
source.excerptNote: An excerpt of the wording under discussion; see the source and attribution limitations below.
source.rightsNote: Nobel’s underlying historical words and this English rendering have separate rights questions. The source gives no translator or first-publication date for the wording, so its rights remain uncertain.
